name: AeroDataBox
tagline: Flight schedules, airport data, and aviation information via RapidAPI
description: AeroDataBox provides flight schedules, airport information, flight status, and aviation data through a REST API hosted on RapidAPI. Developers can look up airports, flights by number or route, and related aviation metadata.

auth.details: RapidAPI key via X-RapidAPI-Key header; also requires X-RapidAPI-Host: aerodatabox.p.rapidapi.com

pricing.free_tier_limits: Basic free plan: 600 API units/month; 1 request/second (RapidAPI also: 1000 requests/hour). Units ≠ requests — endpoint cost varies by Tier.

rate_limits: Published by plan: free Basic 1 req/s (+ 1000 req/hour on RapidAPI); Pro 1 req/s; Ultra 2 req/s; Mega 3 req/s (higher on direct/API.Market plans).
use_cases: look up airport details by IATA or ICAO code
get flight status by flight number
retrieve flight schedules for a route or airport
search flights by departure and arrival airports
get airport runway and location data
